title: ProjectConfig
description: A project's forge configuration, stored at `.forge/project.json`.

testProcess.description: The test commands forge runs: a fast `local` gate on each work item, an optional full `ci` gate before a pull request opens, and an optional `acceptance` tier for live systems.

local.description: The fast gate forge runs on each work item between iterations. It must exit 0 on a green tree. When `cmd` is missing here, forge reads it from the `.forge/quality_gate_cmd` file (one command line split on whitespace); `cmd` in `project.json` wins when both exist. With neither, loading fails.

cmd.description: Command as an argument array. `forge preflight` checks that it is one command, with no `&&`, `;` or pipe chaining, and that it does not run a slow suite such as playwright, cypress, e2e or integration.

timeoutMs.description: Gate timeout in milliseconds. The default is 30 minutes. The `FORGE_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS` environment variable overrides this value.

perWorkItem.description: Gate template as an argument array, for example `["go","test","-count=1","./{package}/..."]`. It holds exactly one `{package}` placeholder, which cannot start a token, and no shell operators. A work item that sets no gate of its own runs this template, with `{package}` replaced by the common directory of the item's files. When those files share no directory below the repository root, `cmd` runs instead.

ci.description: The full CI verification, run once as the last gate before a pull request opens. It mirrors the project's CI workflow. The command runs directly, so a `["bash","-c","a && b"]` chain is allowed here.

cmd.description: Command as an argument array, for example `["bash","-c","make test && make lint"]`.

fixCmd.description: Formatter command as an argument array, run on a best-effort basis before `cmd` so the pull request is formatted.

unsetEnv.description: Environment variable names removed when running `cmd` and `fixCmd`, so the gate runs the same way as CI. Use it for variables that switch on live tests, such as `TF_ACC`. `PATH`, `HOME` and `SHELL` are refused.

timeoutMs.description: Gate timeout in milliseconds. The default is 20 minutes. The `FORGE_CI_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS` environment variable overrides this value.

acceptance.description: The live-acceptance tier, for projects whose behaviour only a live system can prove. Whether an initiative must pass it depends on the acceptance setting of its change class. A `required` key is refused.

match.description: Text that marks a work item's gate as live acceptance: a gate matches when any argument of its command contains it, for example `acceptancetests`. Must not be empty.

requiresEnv.description: Environment variables that must be set for a matching gate to run live, for example `["TF_ACC"]`. When one is unset, the gate fails instead of passing on a skipped test run. Entries must not be empty.

timeoutMs.description: Reserved. Acceptance gates run as work-item gates, so `FORGE_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS` applies.

standing_work_item_acs.description: Acceptance criteria that forge appends to every work item it plans, under a "Standing acceptance criteria" heading.

repo.description: The project's GitHub name as `owner/name`. Webhook events for that repository resolve to this project. A project that omits it matches no event.

northStar.description: One-line mission statement for the project, at most 140 characters.

instructions.description: Standing instructions added to every planning prompt. When the project root has an `AGENTS.md` (or else `CLAUDE.md`) file, its content replaces this value.

demoProcess.description: Ordered demo steps for the demo agent.

kind.description: What the step does: `capture` records evidence, `verify` checks it, `present` attaches it to the pull request.

element.description: Name of a demo element from the demo element library, for a composed demo.

demoMeans.description: What a demo may drive. The demo planner picks each change's evidence form from these means; forge captures and compares the evidence itself.

commands.description: Commands a CLI before/after checkpoint may run. Each runs without a shell, so it may not contain shell operators such as `|`, `;` or `$`.

routes.description: In-app paths a screenshot checkpoint may open, starting `/` with no traversal.

api.description: Means for an API before/after checkpoint, compared as JSON.

paths.description: Paths forge requests with GET on each capture tree's own server. No scheme or host: reach an external API through `commands`.

commands.description: Commands that print a JSON body to standard output, such as the project's own CLI reading a live service with its own credentials.

ignoreKeys.description: Extra key names dropped at any depth before before/after JSON is compared, on top of the default volatile keys (`id`, `node_id`, timestamps, `url`, `*_url`, `etag`, `size`, `watchers`, `watchers_count`).

skills.description: Skill names bound to this project.

kb.description: Knowledge base id bound to this project, or `null` for none.

artifactRoot.description: Project-relative directory that holds the forge artifacts committed in the project repository. Must be a relative path with no leading slash, no backslash and no `..` segment. A value of `.` or an empty string means the project root.

appType.description: Id of the app-type template the project was created from.

buildProcess.description: How the project builds. Both fields are optional.

local.description: Build command as an argument array. An empty array counts as unset.

remote.description: Worktree-relative path to the CI workflow file. No leading slash, backslash or `..` segment.

heartbeat_seconds.description: Seconds between agent heartbeat events. Must be greater than 0.

command.description: Command as an argument array that prints scalar metrics to standard output.

tolerance_pct.description: Percentage drift allowed before a regression is flagged.

start_command.description: Command as an argument array that starts the test bed.

draw_function.description: Worktree-relative path to a module that exports a sample-draw function.

measurement_extractor.description: Worktree-relative path to a module that parses the output of `metrics.command`.

releaseProcess.description: Release preparation that forge does in a cycle before merge. Tagging and publishing are left to CI.

kind.description: `docs` refreshes the project docs, `changelog` writes a changelog entry, `version` bumps the version file.

phase.description: `in-cycle` runs during the build loop with the feature work. `pre-merge` runs after the build loop, before the pull request opens.

command.description: Command as an argument array that performs the step.

versionFile.description: Worktree-relative path to the file that holds the project version. No leading slash, backslash or `..` segment.

changelogPath.description: Worktree-relative path to the changelog. No leading slash, backslash or `..` segment.

docsDir.description: Worktree-relative directory of the project docs. No leading slash, backslash or `..` segment.
